meta.title: Design Studio
meta.description: A design workbench in the right sidebar: web, app, mini program and poster screens generate on a canvas inside device frames; click an element or circle it with the brush to have the model change it, open existing HTML pages to keep working on them, drag sliders to tweak design tokens across every screen, compare and roll back versions, extract a brand's design system from a website, turn a design into React / Vue / HTML code and diff it pixel by pixel, export share-ready images, and scan a QR code to view it on your phone.
